messages:
maria.k: Hey team — need ephemeral elevated access to pull full prod logs for a reproducer on INC-4329. Requesting 1 hour of read-only access to the logs bucket and the redaction helper to verify whether PII masking caused the mismatch. Ping @security for approval.

samir: Can you confirm exactly which resources and the minimal privilege you need?

maria.k: Minimal: s3:GetObject on objects under `s3://prod-logs/kv-cache/2026-03-16/*` and the internal `redact-tool` (no write). I only need to download a handful of objects (~100) to inspect headers + masked fields. Start ASAP if approved; duration 60m.

elena: A couple quick rules before I can sign off: (1) scope the S3 prefix (good), (2) all downloads must go to the company jumpbox `jump-prod-2`, not a personal machine, (3) any unredacted exports require explicit approval and must be stored in `/secure/tmp` and logged.

jordan: Also need PO/owner ack. Who owns INC-4329?

maria.k: PO is @samir, and I have a short note from them in the ticket that this is needed to reproduce a latency regression.

samir: I confirm — PO acked in the ticket. Approve for debug.

elena: OK. Please open a JIT access request so we have an auditable flow. ops-oncall will issue a short-lived role for you.

maria.k: Filed JIT: https://intranet.redwood/ops/jit/requests/ACC-2026-88 — scope attached: 
```
resource: s3://prod-logs/kv-cache/2026-03-16/*
actions: [s3:GetObject]
principal: maria.k
duration: 60m
notes: debug reproducer for INC-4329; PO acked
```

ops-oncall: Received ACC-2026-88. Will provision timeboxed role tied to `jump-prod-2`. Please confirm you'll use `redact-tool --sample 100 --strategy=token` before any export.

maria.k: Confirmed — will run `redact-tool --sample 100 --strategy=token` and paste sanitized sample in the ticket. No exports without prior approval.

elena: Conditional approval granted: one-hour access starting on provisioning. Security will monitor S3 GETs for large bulk pulls; if we see >500MB in 10m we will terminate. Also: do not share raw files in Slack.

security-bot: Access grant event: ACC-2026-88 -> role `jit-prod-logs-readonly` applied to maria.k via ops-oncall. Expires at 1802349278 (1 hour from grant). Audit link: https://audit.redwood/acc/ACC-2026-88

maria.k: Thanks, provisioning succeeded and I'm on `jump-prod-2`. Running the sample now. Will post sanitized output.

samir: Thx — ping me if you need faster traces or helper scripts.

maria.k: Pasted sanitized snippet in ticket INC-4329 (s3 object key: kv-cache/2026-03-16/obj-8421.json, sanitized). Sample shows masked user_id fields as expected, but there's a timestamp skew that looks correlated to batching.

elena: Good. Keep the session focused. If you need to widen prefixes, request a new JIT with justification.

ops-oncall: Reminder: automatic revocation scheduled at 1802349278. We will send a final revocation notice 5 minutes before expiry.

security-bot: Revocation warning: ACC-2026-88 will expire in 5 minutes.

maria.k: Copy. Wrapping up now, deleting any temporary files under `/tmp` on jumpbox and moving artifacts (sanitized) to `/secure/tmp/INC-4329/`.

ops-oncall: Role `jit-prod-logs-readonly` revoked for maria.k at 1802349278.

security-bot: Access revocation event recorded: ACC-2026-88 closed. All activity archived to https://audit.redwood/acc/ACC-2026-88/logs

maria.k: Confirmed I no longer have elevated access. Thanks for quick turnaround. :thumbsup: 

jordan: Great, please leave a summary in the ticket with next steps for a permanent fix.

maria.k: Will do — brief postmortem + repro steps going into INC-4329 now.
